requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.gaps: The attribution matrix was explicit, but the personal-budget identity changed mid-task (email replaced by username as the LiteLLM customer id). Edge cases surfaced only in review: non-member CLI project header, case variants of project names, fallback-default hints for users who are not members (CR-007).

technical_risk.label: XXL
technical_risk.risk_factors: Billing on the hot path of every LLM request; authorization (a CLI header naming a non-member project reached credential lookup, the critical CR finding); personal LiteLLM customer id switched from email to username, which affects existing spend continuity; sync/async twins of the resolver; 60 s funded-probe cache that also caches 'no budget'; contextvar restore for nested assistants and workflow nodes
technical_risk.mitigation: Single pure resolver with sync and async twins; membership check via member_spelling before any credential or budget lookup; funded probe failures fail closed to the next step and are logged; scoped_llm_context restores the caller's context; matrix end-to-end tests plus resolver unit tests; MR should ask a reviewer to post /sanity
